judge.rationale: The production code fix in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` and the unit test in `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` match the reference implementation almost identically. The candidate satisfies all acceptance criteria, including updating the spec with what `afterSession` can assume and adding a migration note to the CHANGELOG. However, the candidate leaves behind an extraneous `.lore/dod.md` file and a duplicate acceptance test file (`chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts`). Additionally, the candidate makes unnecessary edits to unrelated spec files (`hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md`, `hal-engine-tool-responses/spec.md`) and changes the status of `hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` from `Shipped` to `In Progress` while keeping the fixed behavior under the formerly out-of-scope section instead of moving it to the main spec section as the reference did.
